The '''Republic Command Center''' was the primary [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] base in the [[Axial Park]] district of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]].<ref name="Location" /> It was overrun by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Corin Tok]] fell in the base's defense.<ref name="Sacking Gardens">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]|Sacking the Gardens|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref>
